study type: secondary analysis of a multicenter randomized controlled trial
exposure: Embryo stage (two cleavage-stage (day 2 or day 3) frozen embryos)
cohort: 908 patients who underwent transfer of two cleavage-stage (day 2 or day 3) frozen embryos
finding: The natural cycle protocol resulted in thicker endometria, higher implantation rates, and lower caesarean section rates compared to the hormone replacement therapy protocol in the transfer of two cleavage-stage frozen embryos.
